title: Taiwanese Student Association at the University of Virginia
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Association at the University of Virginia (TSA at UVA) is a student organization dedicated to promoting Taiwanese culture and fostering community among those interested in Taiwan’s cultural heritage. The organization maintains an active presence both on campus and online, with a dedicated website at tsaatuva.org, an Instagram account with over 1,200 followers, and a Facebook group.

Membership is open to all UVA students regardless of cultural background; any student with an interest in Taiwanese culture is encouraged to join. The organization is structured with a full executive board—including President, Vice President, Secretary, and Treasurer—as well as committees covering culture, culinary arts, fundraising, publicity, social events, and sports. TSA at UVA is a Contracted Independent Organization (CIO) listed in UVA’s official student organization directory and operates independently from the University.

According to its YouTube channel, TSA at UVA plans various social and cultural events throughout the year “to strengthen ethnic and cultural awareness” and aims to provide a platform for those interested in Taiwan’s social, educational, cultural, and political developments.
